headline: 700 auto-rickshaws: Jamaat demands proof of DNCC chief’s claim
summary: The party called the allegation that its Secretary General owns hundreds of vehicles 'fictitious and baseless' after the DNCC Administrator made the remark.
details: Jamaat-e-Islami has demanded verifiable evidence after Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) Administrator Safiqul Islam Khan alleged that a political leader owns 700 auto-rickshaws.
The DNCC Administrator made the remark on Friday during an artwork programme on the metro rail pillars between Mirpur-12 and Agargaon.
While the administrator did not name the leader, Jamaat said media reports suggested the remarks were aimed at its Secretary General, Mia Golam Porwar.
Jamaat described the allegations as 'fictitious, false, baseless and fabricated', stating that such a serious claim requires specific, reliable evidence.
The party argued that the administrator's conduct of commenting without public proof is not responsible and demanded that the DNCC chief withdraw the remark.
Jamaat further demanded a public apology if the administrator fails to present verifiable evidence to support the claim.
caption:
A political leader owns 700 auto-rickshaws? Jamaat-e-Islami demands proof after DNCC chief's shocking claim.

Jamaat-e-Islami has demanded verifiable evidence after Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) Administrator Safiqul Islam Khan alleged that a political leader owns 700 auto-rickshaws.

The DNCC Administrator made the remark on Friday during an artwork programme on the metro rail pillars between Mirpur-12 and Agargaon.

While the administrator did not name the leader, Jamaat said media reports suggested the remarks were aimed at its Secretary General, Mia Golam Porwar.

Jamaat described the allegations as 'fictitious, false, baseless and fabricated', stating that such a serious claim requires specific, reliable evidence.

The party argued that the administrator's conduct of commenting without public proof is not responsible and demanded that the DNCC chief withdraw the remark.

Jamaat further demanded a public apology if the administrator fails to present verifiable evidence to support the claim.

#Bangladesh #DNCC #Jamaat #Dhaka #Politics #News

Source: Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com, Prothom Alo

headline: Police Additional DIG Tutul Chakraborty dismissed from service for misconduct
summary: The officer was fired after it was proven he falsely claimed to be a 'DIG' to access VIP lounges at the airport.
details: The government has dismissed Police Additional DIG Tutul Chakraborty from service following proven allegations of misconduct and abandoning his workplace without permission.
caption:
Falsely claiming to be a 'DIG' to use VIP lounges? A high-ranking police officer has been dismissed.

The government has dismissed Police Additional DIG Tutul Chakraborty from service following proven allegations of misconduct and abandoning his workplace without permission.
